biggest_catch: Rare Patient Voice officially publishes $120/hour, but publishes no payment timing and no session lengths — so it fails the timing requirement.
catches: No official statement of when or how quickly participants are paid after a study.
No official general session duration; studies range from surveys to advisory boards.
Only patients and family caregivers with qualifying conditions are invited — narrow eligibility.
Third-party claims about check/PayPal/direct-deposit timing were excluded as unofficial.

c1.evidence: Official rarepatientvoice.com describes the patient/caregiver research panel and invitation flow.

c2.evidence: Official 2025 company statement quotes the president: 'we pay respondents for their participation, typically at $120 per hour' (older official page: $100 per hour).

c3.evidence: No payout timing in official terms — no published deadline or payment method schedule.

c4.evidence: Registration described as free; no fee in official materials.

eligibility: Patients and family caregivers with qualifying (often chronic/rare) conditions; invited by email match
maximize: Not verifiable on timing — do not count on fast pay. If you are a patient or caregiver, keep your condition profile current so matching emails reach you; confirm the per-study pay schedule in the invitation before committing.
notes: Strong official pay rate ($120/hour) but zero official timing or duration terms. An honest reject: the rate alone does not make it a same-day route.
payout_quote: Official 2025 statement from RPV's president: 'we pay respondents for their participation, typically at $120 per hour' (older official page stated $100 per hour). Rate is per hour of participation.

s1.note: Hourly participation pay; no expense float.

s6.note: Per-study particulars sent by email; no general duration.

s7.note: Invitations 'from time to time'; no volume guaranteed.
